title: Why North America Can't Build Nice Apartments (because of one rule)
summary: About Here explains how North American building codes requiring two staircases make small multi-story apartment buildings hard to build, and contrasts this with places that allow single-stair designs.
why: HN commenters share it in housing and single-stair egress threads as an enjoyable, accessible explainer of the two-stair rule.

quote.text: I caught a YouTube about this recently that I really enjoyed.
